issues.display_title: Issue #387: Refactor Bookmark Folder Helper to Use GORM Models
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 13/07/26

✅ Implementation: Bookmark Folder Helper Refactoring

This document tracks the execution details for the CheckFolderPublished helper refactoring.

Phase 1: CheckFolderPublished Helper

  • Target File: src/Utils/Functions/BookmarkFunctions/BookmarkFunctions.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added the Models import so the helper can use Models.FolderBookmark.
    • Added the gorm import so the helper can handle gorm.ErrRecordNotFound.
    • Replaced Config.DB.Table("folder_bookmark").Select(...).Scan(&folder) with a model-based Config.DB.Select(...).First(&folderBookmark) query.
    • Converted folderBookmark.ID from uuid.UUID to string before returning the existing FolderStatus type.
    • Safely copied nullable folderBookmark.Slug only when it is not nil.
    • Preserved the existing published-folder guard and error response behavior for callers.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Verification

  • Ran go test ./src/Utils/Functions/BookmarkFunctions ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks.
  • Result: passed with no test files.

Background

The bookmark endpoints already use GORM models for most create, update, and delete operations. The shared CheckFolderPublished helper still queried folder_bookmark through Table(...).Scan(...), which kept one bookmark flow outside the model-based pattern.

Objective

Refactor src/Utils/Functions/BookmarkFunctions/BookmarkFunctions.go so CheckFolderPublished loads folder data through Models.FolderBookmark and handles missing folders with gorm.ErrRecordNotFound.

Scope

  • Replace Config.DB.Table("folder_bookmark").Scan(...) with a model-based First(&Models.FolderBookmark{}) query.
  • Preserve the existing FolderStatus return type so bookmark callers do not need changes.
  • Convert Models.FolderBookmark.ID from uuid.UUID to string for existing callers.
  • Safely copy nullable Slug from *string to string.
  • Return the same existing error responses for missing, published, and failed folder checks.

Acceptance Criteria

  • CheckFolderPublished no longer uses Table("folder_bookmark").
  • The helper uses Models.FolderBookmark.
  • Missing folders are handled through gorm.ErrRecordNotFound.
  • Existing callers in src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ continue to compile unchanged.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Utils/Functions/BookmarkFunctions ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks

issues.display_title: Issue #388: Refactor LikeComment Query Result Handling
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 13/07/26

✅ Implementation: LikeComment Query Result Refactoring

This document tracks the execution details for the LikeComment query result refactoring.

Phase 1: Typed Comment Lookup Result

  • Target File: src/Action/V1/Likes/LikeComment.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added a local commentLikeTarget struct with explicit id, slug, and visibility GORM column mappings.
    • Replaced comments := make(map[string]interface{}) with var commentTarget commentLikeTarget.
    • Changed qComment.Take(&comments) to qComment.Take(&commentTarget) and handled the returned error directly.
    • Added explicit gorm.ErrRecordNotFound handling for missing comments.
    • Replaced map type assertions with typed field access through commentTarget.ID, commentTarget.Slug, and commentTarget.Visibility.
    • Preserved the existing joined query and blocked-user / blocked-post filters.
  • Status: Completed & Compiled Successfully.

Verification

  • Ran go test ./src/Action/V1/Likes.
  • Result: passed with no test files.

Background

LikeComment still used map[string]interface{} to read the selected comment, post visibility, and slug fields from a joined query. This made the code depend on runtime type assertions and kept the query result less explicit than nearby GORM model-based code.

Objective

Refactor src/Action/V1/Likes/LikeComment.go to use a typed query result struct for the comment lookup while preserving the existing join filters for blocked users and blocked posts.

Scope

  • Replace map[string]interface{} query result handling with a typed struct.
  • Keep the existing joined query against comments, posts, and users because blocked-user and blocked-post filters depend on those tables.
  • Handle gorm.ErrRecordNotFound explicitly for missing comments.
  • Remove direct type assertions for id, slug, and visibility.
  • Preserve existing success responses, like/unlike behavior, and private-comment validation.

Acceptance Criteria

  • LikeComment no longer stores the comment lookup result in map[string]interface{}.
  • The comment lookup remains compatible with both slug and slim ID modes.
  • Blocked post and blocked user filters remain in place.
  • Missing comments still return 409 Comment Not Found.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Likes
